The sole receipt linked by this archive’s reconciliation.md is initiative receipts/c16-practical-team-presets-20261008.json. The reconciliation itself describes this evidence as "root review". These mapped facts support the historical operation and root artifact assessment, but leave the explicit independent delivery-review clause unproved; this is an accounting gap, not a claim that no historical review ever occurred.
